events.means: This works：讲解卡外框画出，五站路从上往下画出
not yet：patients 旁红批注 not yet
narrows：computer 旁长出漏斗，一片点落进去
search：漏斗底下只漏出两三个点
decide：flask 往下的红虚线箭头指到 animals、patients
a cancer drug：标题后半写出，下面划红线
really is：报纸缩小移到卡顶
scientists：科学家站到 computer 旁
trial and error：computer 外画一个循环箭头，转起来
Thanks：五站从上往下全亮，路变红

sentences.text: This works in cells, not yet in people.
So next time you see a headline like 'AI discovers a cancer drug'...
...ask where it really is on the road: computer, protein, cells, animals, or patients?
It gave them trial and error at light speed.
